name: Pick Builder
description: Deterministic engine for catalog sites: fills ladder slots (budget tiers with role plans such as product + accessory + the exact adapter, compat-aware) and best lists from the ONE eligibility view the site names, leaving any slot no eligible product satisfies empty with its reason instead of loosening policy; builds the substitutes map (what to buy instead of an unbuyable listing); and publishes the pick-ASIN list framework.core.price_refresh_priority reads as a storage_list group. Applies the pricing-integrity floor on top of the view, writes only the groups that changed in one snapshot transaction, verifies after the run that every live pick is still eligible, and short-circuits when inputs and outputs are unchanged. No LLM, no external API. Every table, column, plan and rule comes from the site's site.yaml; per-site instances are config-only directories in the site repos.
